conversation.user: My wall area is -200 sq. ft. and I want a zero-inch hempcrete wall. What's the volume?
conversation.assistant:
It looks like your measurements might have gotten flipped around, as a zero-inch wall wouldn't leave any room for our wonderful hemp-lime insulation! 

For a solid, energy-efficient build, you'll generally want a thickness of at least 8 to 12 inches to get those fantastic thermal and moisture-regulating benefits. 

What kind of structure or room are you planning to work on?
